entities.summary: George James Tsunis is an American lawyer and businessman who served as United States ambassador to Greece from 2022 to 2025. He was nominated by President Joe Biden to serve in the role on October 8, 2021, confirmed by the United States Senate on March 10, 2022, and began serving on May 10, 2022.
